report.status_line: Critical: Water trailer tank ruptured en route with ~360 L projected remaining; ATV 3 and 5 offline; propane depleting in ~8 days.

concerns.title: Trailer water tank ruptured and water depletion risk
concerns.detail: The crew reported that the trailer water tank ruptured en route and requires replacement. Static water tank reads 15 cm, and total water is estimated at ~360 L. Note that these are projections from one crew estimate, not measurements: if usage matched the Arctic analog (FMARS) average of 12.12 L per person-day, water would last about 4.2 days and run out on 2015-01-17, before mission end on 2015-01-23 (10 days away). At the NASA potable minimum of 2.5 L per person-day, water would last about 20.6 days (running out on 2015-02-02). Reaching mission end requires a daily budget of about 5.1 L per person-day for the 7 crew members.

concerns.title: Propane depletion projected before mission end
concerns.detail: Propane is at 40%, down from 45% yesterday (-5 percent/day). At this draw rate, propane is forecast to deplete in about 8 days, running out before mission end on 2015-01-23 (10 days away). This is an early estimate based on 2 readings.

concerns.title: ATV 3 and ATV 5 operational failures
concerns.detail: The crew reported that ATV 3 powered on but shut down after 20 seconds, and ATV 5 failed to start completely, constraining rover availability for scheduled EVAs.

concerns.title: Hab hot water unavailable
concerns.detail: The crew reported that hot water has still not been attained in the habitat.

crew_actions: Implement water conservation measures targeting the daily budget of about 5.1 L per person per day to reach mission end.
Troubleshoot ATV 3 and ATV 5 electrical systems, batteries, and fuel lines.
Continue investigating the water heater setup and controls to establish hot water.
Change the equipment cover setup to use an extra mattress as requested for easier glove handling.
Log daily measurements of propane, static tank levels, and diesel.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Authorize trailer water tank replacement or emergency water resupply logistics, and provide water shortage procedures.
decisions_for_earth.why: The trailer tank broke en route and projected total water of about 360 L may deplete in about 4.2 days at typical analog usage rates.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve or decline the requested EVA for Jan 14th 2015.
decisions_for_earth.why: Earth authorization is required for EVA approval, especially with ATV 3 and ATV 5 currently non-operational.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Plan propane resupply logistics if daily consumption continues at -5 percent per day.
decisions_for_earth.why: Propane is projected to deplete in about 8 days at 40 percent remaining, prior to scheduled mission end in 10 days.

report.message_to_earth: Status: Habitat condition is critical due to a ruptured trailer water tank. What happened: At 12:35pm, the crew reported that the trailer water tank ruptured en route, leaving total water projected at about 360 L for 7 crew members. What the crew is doing: The crew is conserving water and troubleshooting rovers ATV 3 and ATV 5. Other systems: Diesel is nominal at 75 percent, propane is at 40 percent with about 8 days left, and hot water is unavailable. Request: Provide guidance on trailer tank replacement and decision on the Jan 14th 2015 EVA by tonight. Next update: Next update tomorrow with the daily engineering report.
